distribution.narrative: Li et al. (2021) reported repeated detections of Ips calligraphus around Zhuhai, Guangdong since 2016; the 2019 survey found the species at four sites. The authors considered the population established and described the report as the first record in mainland Asia. The specimens were not assigned to a subspecies in the published record.

host_note: Gut-content rbcL sequences were successfully obtained from three I. calligraphus individuals and grouped with slash pine Pinus elliottii. This direct molecular feeding-host evidence is promoted as Current Host Summary. No native Chinese pine is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: Chinese occurrence records are identified at species rank as Ips calligraphus (Germar, 1823). Johnson et al. (2026) recognizes three subspecies, but the published Chinese records do not establish a subspecific identification.
